# Device Tree screenshot fixture

https://github.com/torvalds/linux/blob/v6.6/arch/arm64/boot/dts/freescale/imx8mp-evk.dts

This is a screenshot input, not a standalone build: its includes and board
bindings belong to the upstream Linux source tree.
